facts.fact: The Forum Chawki Gaddes, in a statement of 3 October 2026, cites organic law no. 63 of 2004 as the law guaranteeing personal data protection and says the legal framework of the data protection authority remains in force.

The Forum says the activities of the national personal data protection authority (INPDP) are at a standstill and calls for its reactivation, so no application by the authority is current; the date the activity stopped is not given.
